newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong boatpeople population dips below 10,000.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong boatpeople population dips below 10,000.

text.p: Hong Kong repatriated another 237 Vietnamese boatpeople on Friday, taking the number still in the British colony to below 10,000, the government said.
It said in statement there were now 9,924 boatpeople left in the territory -- the lowest in almost eight years -- after the latest batch were voluntarily repatriated.
Hong Kong aims to clear its camps before it reverts to Chinese rule on July 1, 1997.
The territory is home to the largest remaining boatpeople population in East Asia, the last of a wave who fled their country in rickety boats after the Vietnam War ended in 1975.
